captions.detailed: A tandem stoker crankset featuring two separate bottom bracket assemblies connected by a central black tube. Each bottom bracket has a pair of light gray crank arms, which are connected via a black timing chain running along large silver chainrings. Four black pedals with orange safety reflectors are attached to the outer ends of the crank arms. The entire crankset system is designed so that both spindle/arm assemblies rotate continuously about their respective bottom-bracket axes, while each individual pedal rotates about its own spindle axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a tandem stoker crankset with two separate bottom brackets connected by a frame tube and a timing chain. The model should include rotatable crank arms with chainrings, a timing chain, and four individual pedals with orange reflectors, ensuring continuous rotational joints for the cranksets and separate revolute joints for each pedal.
captions.factory: Construct the main frame using a central box tube and two cylindrical bottom bracket shells. Model the crank arms by combining cylinders and boxes to form the offset arm shape, and model the chainrings as flat cylinders with cutouts. Create the timing chain by sweeping a small profile or combining long cylinders and arcs. Assemble the components using continuous joints for the front and rear crank spindles relative to the bottom brackets, and add revolute joints for each of the four pedals relative to their respective crank arm ends.
